name: O-GlcNAcase

function.text: OGA encodes protein O-GlcNAcase. Annotated molecular activities include hexosaminidase activity and hyalurononglucosaminidase activity. It participates in protein deglycosylation and N-acetylglucosamine metabolic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
